description: Match begins at GEHA Field at Arrowhead Stadium.
Alexis Mac Allister heads home from Lionel Messi's corner. 1-0 Argentina.
Foul on Enzo Fernández, free kick to Argentina.
Argentina's second corner of the match.
Switzerland attacker flagged offside.
Half time: Argentina 1-0 Switzerland.
Foul on Xhaka, free kick to Switzerland.
Switzerland's first corner of the match.
Dan Ndoye curls a finish home from a narrow angle. 1-1.
Leandro Paredes initially shown a yellow card for a foul on Breel Embolo.
VAR review determines Embolo was already going to ground before contact; the card is reassigned from Paredes to Embolo as simulation/diving.
Breel Embolo shown a second yellow (reassigned card) and sent off - the first application of IFAB's 'mistaken identity' VAR protocol at a men's World Cup. Switzerland reduced to 10 men.
Argentina press the 10-man Swiss back-line but the final ball is cut out.
Nicolás González replaces Nicolás Tagliafico.
Lautaro Martínez replaces Rodrigo De Paul.
Gonzalo Montiel replaces Nahuel Molina.
Thiago Almada replaces Alexis Mac Allister (estimated minute/pairing, see README).
Full time: Argentina 1-1 Switzerland after 90 minutes. Match goes to extra time.
Extra time begins.
Kobel keeps Switzerland level early in extra time.
Second period of extra time begins.
Nicolás Otamendi replaces Lisandro Martínez (estimated minute/pairing, see README).
Rubén Vargas replaces Remo Freuler.
José Manuel López replaces Lionel Messi (estimated minute/pairing, see README).
Julián Álvarez strikes a right-footed rocket into the far upper corner. 2-1 Argentina (extra time).
Lautaro Martínez turns in the rebound after Thiago Almada's initial shot is kept out. 3-1 Argentina. (120+1')
Full time (AET): Argentina 3-1 Switzerland. Argentina advance to face England in the semi-final in Atlanta.
